changeSet.author: rishabh

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='c_users' AND column_name='email' AND data_type='bytea'

changeSet.comment: Force-fix email and password columns from bytea to varchar (idempotent)
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE c_users ALTER COLUMN email TYPE varchar(255) USING convert_from(email, 'UTF8'); ALTER TABLE c_users ALTER COLUMN password TYPE varchar(512) USING convert_from(password, 'UTF8');
